'''Hestria''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]. It was known for the [[Wine/Legends|wines]] produced there. Around [[3643 BBY]], the [[government of Hestria]] shut down its [[Hestria secret police force|secret police force]] that had been attempting to influence the governments of all the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of the [[Hestria system/Legends|Hestria system]].

==Description==
Hestria was a thriving [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[Hestria system/Legends|Hestria system]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Angratha system/Legends|Angratha]], [[Kedorzha system/Legends|Kedorzha]], and [[Simoom system/Legends|Simoom systems]]. The [[Planet/Legends|world]] was known for the [[Wine/Legends|wines]] produced there,<ref name="TEA" /> which included [[Hestrian wine]].<ref name="GG10" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==History==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Cleaning House" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the [[government of Hestria]] operated a [[Hestria secret police force|secret police force]] that was notoriously corrupt and participated in attempts to influence the governments of all the planets of the Hestria [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Hestria's government shut down the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]]. An individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] subsequently sent a companion to investigate the police force's secret files before the government destroyed them, which the companion successfully did.<ref name="Cleaning House" />
{{Endgame}}

After the [[Colonist/Legends|settlement]] of the Senex-Juvex around [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] by a group of [[Currency/Legends|affluent]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] inhabitants led by the enterpreneur [[Thull Vandron]], Hestria, like the other worlds in the region, came under the control of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] that eventually ruled there.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hestria was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" /> The world was subsequently mentioned in an Investigation Crew Skill mission of the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Cleaning House" />
